objective.statement: Name a time as duple, triple or quadruple, and say which beat note it uses.
successCriteria: I know duple means 2 beats, triple 3 and quadruple 4.
I can name the time from the top number.
I can tell the beat note from the bottom number.

explanation.text: A time signature can be described in two parts: how many beats in a bar, and what kind of beat.
Two beats in a bar is called duple time. Three beats is triple time. Four beats is quadruple time.

music.questionAlternative: Bar 1: minim, minim. Bar 2: dotted minim, crotchet.
Bar 1: quaver, quaver, quaver. Bar 2: crotchet, quaver.

explanation.text: The same set of notes can be felt in different ways, so always read the signature, not just the notes. Four crotchets can be 4/4 (quadruple) or, grouped in twos, two beats of a minim in 2/2.
Duple = 2, triple = 3, quadruple = 4. The top number gives the name; the bottom number gives the beat.

music.textAlternative: One bar of 4/2: four minims, quadruple time.

steps: Count 1, 2, 3, 4: four beats, so it is quadruple time.
Each beat is a minim, because the bottom number is 2.
So 4/2 is quadruple time with minim beats.
demonstration.textAlternative: A bar of 4/2 with four minims: quadruple time with minim beats.

guided.prompt: Is 2/2 duple, triple or quadruple time?

triple.reason: Triple time has 3 beats in a bar. 2/2 has 2, so it is duple.

quadruple.reason: Quadruple time has 4 beats in a bar. 2/2 has 2, so it is duple.

hints: The top number counts the beats; the bottom number names the beat note.
Duple means two beats in a bar, triple means three and quadruple means four. Count the beats from the top number.

feedback.correct: Yes: you named the time from its top number.

mistakes.beat-count-wrong: Count the beats in one complete bar again — that gives the top number.
mistakes.beat-unit-wrong: The beat count is right, but what kind of note is each beat? That gives the bottom number.
mistakes.simple-compound-confusion: Do the beats split into two or into three? Two means simple time; three means compound.

feedback.fallback: Not quite. Find the beat first, then count how many fit in a bar.
